description: Generate a due-diligence report for a Czech IČO from public state sources. depth=basic (free): ARES company facts (name, address, legal form, founding date, NACE), VR statutory body with an EU+OFAC sanctions check per member and for the company, ADIS VAT-payer status, reliability and published bank accounts, a VR ownership-network teaser, and red_flags[] with a 0-100 score computed from those flags. depth=full (DD+, paid; returns tier_required on the free tier): adds ISIR insolvency for the company and for statutory members, their prior insolvent companies, and a virtual-address check. Hosted free limit: 100 tool calls per day per IP, no sign-in. Output: markdown summary + full JSON report. Sample report: https://cz-agents.dev/sample-report/

depth.description: basic = ARES + sanctions only; full = + ISIR insolvency + virtual-address probe.

name: get_dd_report
